correctness.rationale: Verified exact ratio interval max_V M in [7553888936545658/2485078816758705, 61/20] ~ [3.03970,3.05] for k=32, V=span{1,s,...,s^6,x1}. Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: Gram rebuild MATCHES, L re-evaluates exactly, U LDL 8 pivots >0, admissibility p<=32 OK, VERIFY_OK. Manually re-derived all Gram formulas from first principles: A[m][n]=1/(m+n+32) via S-density S^31/31!; A[m][7]=1/(32(m+33)) via E[x1|S]=S/32; A[7][7]=2/(34*33*32) via Dirichlet(1s) second moment; sym-sym J via (1-S^{m+1})(1-S^{n+1})/((m+1)(n+1)) with S31 moments; cross J1/J2 and B[7][7] via (t,u) rest_moment with Beta factors — all match code. LDL logic valid: U*A-B PSD implies M<=U for all nonzero F since A PD (checked PD independently). Threshold calibration verified against Maynard Prop 4.2 r_k=ceil(theta*M/2): needs M>2/theta for >=2 primes and M>4/theta for >=3; at BV theta=1/2 needs M>4 and M>8; at theta~1 needs M>4 for triple. Since U=3.05<4, claims (a) no unconditional DHL[32,2]/[32,3] from V, (b) no conditional triple even under EH, (c) conditional double once theta>2/M~0.658 are all correct. Admissibility independently re-checked for all p<=32 with logged missing residues. No unconditional prime corollary claimed; scope honestly limited to V; two fixed bugs disclosed.

originality.rationale: Compared substantively against nearest priors: Maynard 1311.4600 (general M_k framework, M_5>2, M_105>4, M_k>log k-2loglog k-2, H1<=600) and Polymath 8b 1407.4897 (H1<=246, DHL[50,2], DHL[35410,3], computed M_54>4.00238, M_{50,1/25}>4.0043, M_{4,eps}>=2.05411) plus Zhang-type equidistribution 1402.0811. None records a certificate for the exact k=32 symmetric-degree<=6 plus one asymmetric-cell V=span{1,s,...,s^6,x1} extremal ratio, nor the complementary [3.0397,3.05] upper bound. General asymptotics M_k~log k do not mechanically imply the restricted-cell optimum (log32~3.47 exceeds it). The interval, coefficient vector, Gram matrices, and admissibility witness are new auditable data, not a reprint of tuple tables or OEIS data. Timestamp/failed search not used as proof; substantive non-overlap established.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: extremal Maynard-Tao ratio over the documented k=32 8-dim Ritz-Galerkin cell V, with interval width ~0.01. Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the bounded-gap sieve-vs-distribution interface (target DHL[32,3]/barrier via Maynard Prop 4.2); value was not known or implied by asymptotics; future weight-design searches can reuse the I/J template and need the precise barrier (U=3.05<4 rules out unconditional doubles/triples from V and triples even under EH, while L>=3.0397 quantifies conditional double threshold theta>0.658). This is the pre-registered optimality-barrier fallback in sharp corrected form, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Narrow scope is honestly disclaimed (binds only V, tuple is witness-only) which per standard does not erase the independently valuable exact headline.
